value.rationale: A strict two-bit transmission budget makes optimal nonadaptive sensor placement natural for Gaussian integral recovery. The theorem gives a complete exact optimization across all placements, including potentially asymmetric designs, and a sharp information limit 63.8028%, contrasted with one sign 47.7465% and two real samples 88.8889%. The global asymmetry exclusion and narrow fixed hardware budget are mathematically meaningful, not a routine corollary, even without a broader downstream theorem.
